transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Try to keep it light.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful. I also wanted to ask, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops or dry eye treatment before your operation, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running low, your GP should be able to provide more.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Okay, great to know. Another thing I've noticed is that I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
It’s normal for the eye to be a bit sensitive to light as it adjusts to the new lens. If it’s just mild and things seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside can help.  

But if it’s severe, or you have pain and a red eye as well, it would need checking.  

Do you have any other questions?
transcript.delivered: It’s normal for the eye to be a bit sensitive to light as it adjusts to the new lens. If it’s just mild and things seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside can help.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Oh, I see. One more question, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation, and it should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting much worse, it may need checking.  

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I think that covers everything I was wondering about. Thank you for the information!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they've all been answered. Thank you for your help!
